name: app-dark-olive-fitness-screens-with-lime-highlights
title: Cycling app on dark olive with lime toggles, route line and tap-to-start bar
whatItIs: Three dark phone screens with a green-black gradient: a notification list with lime icons, a settings page with lime toggles, and a run screen with a dark map, a lime route, a stats card and a big lime Tap To Start bar. A lime circular button sits in the centre of the tab bar.
whatItMeans: Energetic and focused; lime on olive-black feels like night training.
techniques: Use one lime accent for toggles, route and primary buttons.
Keep panels as slightly lighter dark cards.
Show a lime route line on a desaturated map.
Centre a circular lime button in the nav.

vocabulary.definition: A switch coloured lime when on.
A prominent round button in the middle of a tab bar.
A highlighted path on a map.
A slightly lighter panel on a dark background.
